questions.prompt: Which Hunyuan model should generate the 3D tile assets?
questions.description: Your original request named HY World 2.1. Tencent's World repository currently links 2.1 to its hosted product, while the downloadable world-generation instructions cover 2.0. Hunyuan3D 2.1 is a different, downloadable mesh-generation model suited to producing GLB tile assets. I need to keep this distinction explicit before spending your VM credits. The game keeps free 3D movement, modern Three.js rendering, WFC assembly, and at least 24 biome buckets either way.

options.label: Hunyuan3D 2.1 for tile meshes
options.description: Use the downloadable asset-generation model on the B200; cache tiles by biome.

options.label: Keep HY World 2.1 specifically
options.description: Supply its available model or API access details, or investigate access before starting the VM.

options.label: Both, with separate roles
options.description: Hunyuan3D makes modular assets; HY World provides larger scene generation when its runtime is available.

questions.prompt: What connection details can I use when the VM is ready?
questions.description: Provide the SSH username and host/IP, the local SSH key path if needed, and the VM image/OS. Do not paste private key contents or passwords. If it is still off, say so; I will finish local preparation first. No VM has been created or started by me.
